unit.why: A short homiletic frame (the tsaddik benefits Israel by telling stories) leads into an anecdote: an arendar facing eviction comes to R. Israel of Ruzhin, who only tells stories and then dismisses him, saying the good has already been done.

stories.start_quote: טו) מה נעשה לאחותינו במה יכול
stories.summary_en: An arendar whose lord wants to evict him from his lease before Passover comes to R. Israel of Ruzhin. The rebbe tells stories throughout the man's plea, then says the good has already been done for him and sends him off in peace. This illustrates the teaching that a tsaddik's storytelling benefits Israel.
